body.heading: Where in the world is Panama?
paragraphs: Panama is a country in Central America, which is part of North America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Panama is Panama City.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Panama is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Panama is the Panamanian balboa. Panama's own coins are balboas, and its paper money is US dollars — the two work side by side.

body.heading: How big is Panama?
paragraphs: Panama covers about 75,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Belize.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: At Miraflores, watch giant ships rise and fall through the canal's locks from the visitor centre terraces — engineering you can see working.
The old town mixes Spanish, French and Caribbean styles in plazas and churches, with rooftop views back to the modern skyline across the bay.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Panama on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
